notebook_title: VEDU 5 Seeds 2 Protocols BPR GRU HUSPM
notes: Executed on Kaggle CPU with two public datasets, two temporal protocols and five locked seeds.
Paired significance was computed after the locked Kaggle run from the 20 saved per-user rank files; it did not retrain or tune a model.
The external datasets support offline ranking evaluation only and are not represented as real VEDU learner logs.
